verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Floot lets you export code/database for self-hosting (floot-docs-11, floot-docs-33), but there is no mention anywhere of a GitHub repository integration or two-way sync capability, which is a reasonable and common expectation for an AI app builder. missing for 10: any GitHub connection/export-to-repo feature, any two-way sync or pull-based update mechanism, any git-based version control integration.
